units.source_text: 浮舟实在心绪恶劣得很。

en.t: Ukifune was in a truly wretched state of mind.

units.source_text: 但乳母竭力怂恿她去，对她说道：“不去实在不好，会使夫人怀疑真有什么事情。

en.t: But her nurse urged her with all her might to go, saying to her, "It would really be wrong not to go; it would make the lady suspect that something truly had happened.

units.source_text: 你只要坦然地前去访问好了。

en.t: You need only go and visit her calmly.

units.source_text: 至于右近等人，我会把这事从头叙述给她们听的。”

en.t: As for Ukon and the others, I will explain the whole matter to them from the beginning."

units.source_text: 她就走到二女公子的纸隔扇面前，叫道：“请右近姐姐出来，有话奉告！”

en.t: She then went to the paper sliding door of the Second Princess and called, "Sister Ukon, please come out; I have something to tell you!"

units.source_text: 乳母对她说道：“我家小姐刚才遭逢了那件奇怪的事情，受惊之余，身体发热，实在痛苦得很，叫人看了十分可怜。

en.t: The nurse said to her, "My young lady just suffered that strange incident, and after such a fright she has developed a fever and is in terrible distress; it is pitiful to see.

units.source_text: 请你带她到夫人那里，给她些安慰吧。

en.t: Please take her to the lady and give her some comfort.

units.source_text: 小姐自身毫无过失，叫她如此受惊，实甚冤枉！

en.t: The young lady herself has done nothing wrong, so it is terribly unfair that she should be frightened like this!

units.source_text: 若是略微懂得男女之道的人，还稍好些。

en.t: If she were someone who knew even a little of relations between men and women, it might be somewhat better.

units.source_text: 可是我家小姐全不懂得，当然十分可怜。”

en.t: But my young lady understands none of it at all, so of course she is deeply to be pitied."

units.source_text: 她就扶起浮舟来，叫她去见二女公子。

en.t: She then helped Ukifune up and made her go to see the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 浮舟已经气得发昏，只觉得在人前怕羞。

en.t: Ukifune was already dizzy with anger and felt only shame at being before others.

units.source_text: 但因性情过分柔顺，就让她们推送到二女公子房中去坐下。

en.t: But because her nature was far too yielding, she let them push her along into the Second Princess's room and sat down there.

units.source_text: 她的额发沾着眼泪，湿得厉害，她就背向灯火，以便隐藏。

en.t: The hair on her forehead was soaked with tears, so she turned her back to the lamplight in order to hide it.

units.source_text: 在一向认为二女公子的美貌无与伦比的众侍女看来，浮舟的姿色也并不逊色，确有高尚的美质。

en.t: To the waiting women, who had always thought the Second Princess's beauty beyond compare, Ukifune's looks were not inferior either, and she truly possessed a noble beauty.

units.source_text: 当时只有右近和少将君两人在侧，浮舟要躲也躲不过。

en.t: At that time only Ukon and Shosho no Kimi were beside her, yet Ukifune could not hide even if she wanted to.

units.source_text: 两人仔细端详她，想道：“亲王如果看上了这个人，定会闹出大事来。

en.t: The two examined her closely and thought, "If the prince takes a liking to this woman, it will surely cause a great disturbance.

units.source_text: 他生性爱新弃旧，只要是新的，即使姿色寻常的也要追求呢。”

en.t: By nature he loves the new and casts aside the old; as long as something is new, he will pursue it even if its beauty is ordinary."
